notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Newly added:
Now the store refresh has exclusive special effects
Added some bullet effects and bullet special effects
Updated and optimized some text descriptions
Added a new portal
Added new props

Optimization:
Optimized the stuttering caused by too many gun emplacements on the field
Optimized the generation logic of the portal

Modification:
The key effect has been changed to take effect immediately upon purchase
Modified some items that can be generated in the portal
The effect of the soul has been modified

Fix bug:
Fixed the issue where stars sometimes fail to attack targets correctly
Fixed that frogs can eat themselves
Fixed the issue of sometimes not being able to pick up items properly
Fixed the issue of sometimes unable to view item information properly
Fixed the issue of sometimes not being able to click buttons properly
Fixed the issue where refreshing the store sometimes causes existing items to disappear
Fixed abnormal display when refreshing amount decreases
Fixed abnormal bullet penetration
